What is branding?

Pixelbrahma is a branding agency that builds distinctive brand identities and the print, packaging, retail, outdoor and broadcast materials that carry them, for businesses in India, Canada and elsewhere.

What strategic branding does for you

  • 01

    A unique identity

    We define what makes you different, then give it a name, a look and a voice that nobody else can use.

  • 02

    Recognition and customer loyalty

    People return to brands they recognise and trust. A consistent system makes that recognition effortless.

  • 03

    A stronger online presence

    Clear visual rules make your website, social media and ads feel like one coherent brand.

Mistakes to avoid when planning a brand

Short, practical lessons from projects like yours.

  1. Mistake 1

    Starting with a logo before a position

    Do this instead

    Define who you serve and what makes you different first, then design the identity around that idea.

  2. Mistake 2

    Using different looks on every channel

    Do this instead

    Create one set of rules for colour, type and layout so packaging, print and screens feel like one brand.

  3. Mistake 3

    Copying a competitor's style

    Do this instead

    Study competitors to find what to avoid, then choose a direction only you can own.

What to prepare before we start on a brand

Having these ready lets us give you a sharper estimate and a faster first draft.

Send us your brief
  • A description of your business, customers and competitors
  • Your current logo and materials, if any
  • Where the brand will appear first: packaging, shop, web or print
  • Brands you admire and why

What decides the cost of branding

We never quote blindly. After a short discovery call we send a written estimate that lists exactly what is included, so you can compare it with confidence.

Get a written estimate
  • +How many touchpoints the identity must cover, from a logo to packaging and signage
  • +Design depth: from template-based layouts to fully custom work
  • +Content: whether you supply copy and images or we create them
  • +Timeline: urgent launches need more people working in parallel
  • +Support: a one-off delivery or an ongoing monthly retainer

Branding agency FAQs

Scope, cost, timeline and process, answered.

Ask us directly
What is branding?

Branding is how a business is recognised and remembered: its name, logo, visual style, tone of voice and every customer experience that reflects them.

Where should a new brand start?

Usually with positioning and a logo, followed by the materials you will use first, such as packaging, brochures or signage.

Can you refresh an existing brand?

Yes. We audit what already works, keep the equity you have built and update what feels dated.

Do you handle printing?

We prepare production-ready artwork and can coordinate with printers.

How much does a branding project cost?

A branding project can be as small as a logo or as large as a complete identity with packaging, print and signage. We quote after a discovery call and put the scope in writing.

What is included in a brand identity package?

Typically a logo with its variations, colour palette, typography, usage guidelines and the first set of applications such as stationery, social templates or packaging.

Do you offer branding services in Bengaluru, Kochi and Canada?

Yes. We work with start-ups and established companies in India and Canada, and can support print production and installation in each market.

How long does a branding project take?

A logo can take a few weeks, a full identity usually takes longer. We agree a timeline at the start with review points after research, concepts and refinement.
